summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of NoFlop.ai startup idea validation app. All core functionality working correctly including backend APIs, frontend UI, AI integration, shareable links, error handling, and mobile responsiveness.

design_issues.issue: Browser clipboard permission error prevents copying links (security limitation, not code issue)

passed_tests: POST /api/validate with startup idea returns structured JSON with all 4 sections
Frontend loads with hero section, textarea, and 'Be Brutal' button
Hero section displays correct heading 'Don't let your idea flop.'
Idea submission shows loading state and displays result with all sections
Shareable link ?r={id} loads result correctly with pre-filled idea
Error handling works for short/empty ideas
AI integration with Claude Sonnet 4.5 generates proper responses
MongoDB storage and retrieval of results works
All result sections display (Signal, Score, Brutal Truth, User Questions)
